job: A blameless man. A heavenly court. Have you considered my servant Job? All he has is in your hand.
Skin for skin. Sores from foot to head. Curse God and die. He will not. Friends sit seven days in silence.
Job opens his mouth and curses his day. Why did I not die at birth?
Eliphaz: who that was innocent ever perished? A word stolen to me in the night.
Eliphaz: happy is the one whom God reproves. Do not despise the Almighty’s discipline.
Job: oh that my vexation were weighed. A despairing man should have the kindness of his friend.
Job: my flesh is clothed with worms. What is man, that you make so much of him?
Bildad: does God pervert justice? If you are pure, he will rouse himself for you.
Job: how can a man be in the right before God? He is not a man, as I am, that I might answer him.
Job: I loathe my life. Your hands fashioned me. Remember that you have made me like clay.
Zophar: a multitude of words should be answered. If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away.
Job: no doubt you are the people, and wisdom will die with you. I am not inferior to you.
Job: he would slay me; I have no hope. Yet I will argue my ways to his face.
Eliphaz: why does your heart carry you away? What is man, that he can be clean?
Job: miserable comforters are you all. My witness is in heaven.
Job: my spirit is broken. If I look for Sheol as my house — where then is my hope?
Bildad: why are we counted as cattle? The light of the wicked is put out.
Job: how long will you torment me? I know that my Redeemer lives.
Zophar: the triumphing of the wicked is short. Heaven will reveal his iniquity.
Job: why do the wicked live, reach old age, and grow mighty in power?
Eliphaz: is not your evil great? Is not God high in the heavens?
Job: oh that I knew where I might find him. He knows the way that I take.
Job: why are not times of judgment kept by the Almighty? The murderer, the thief, the adulterer.
Bildad: dominion and fear are with God. How then can man be right?
Job: how you have helped him who has no power. He hangs the earth on nothing.
Job: I will never put away my integrity. I hold fast my righteousness.
Job: surely there is a mine for silver. Where is wisdom found? The fear of the Lord.
Job’s former days: when the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were around me.
Job’s present: they abhor me, they stand aloof. My lyre is turned to mourning.
A final oath: if I have walked with falsehood — let thistles grow instead of wheat. The words of Job are ended.
Elihu’s anger. I am young. The spirit in man, the breath of the Almighty, makes him understand.
Elihu: Job has spoken without knowledge. God is greater than man. Why do you contend against him?
Elihu: if a messenger, a mediator, one of a thousand. Return, deliver him from going down to the pit.
Elihu: far be it from God that he should do wickedness. He shows no partiality to princes.
Elihu: God thunders with his voice. Stop and consider the wondrous works of God.
Elihu: do you know how God lays his command upon them? The cattle also, concerning the storm.
The Lord answers Job out of the whirlwind. Where were you when I laid the foundation of the earth?
Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades? Who provides for the raven? The war horse, the hawk.
Behold Behemoth. Can you draw out Leviathan with a fishhook? Who then is he who can stand before me?
Leviathan continued: on earth there is not his like. He looks down on all that are haughty.
Job: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you. I despise myself and repent in dust and ashes.
The friends are wrong. Job prays for them. Twice as much as he had before. He dies old and full of days.
psalms: Two ways: the blessed, and the wicked like chaff. The Lord knows the way of the righteous.
Why do the nations rage? You are my Son. Kiss the Son, lest he be angry.
A psalm of David fleeing Absalom. Salvation belongs to the Lord.
Answer me when I call. In peace I will both lie down and sleep.
Give ear to my words. You are not a God who delights in wickedness.
O Lord, rebuke me not in your anger. I am weary with my moaning.
In you I take refuge. The Lord judges the peoples. My shield is with God.
How majestic is your name. What is man, that you are mindful of him?
The wicked sit in ambush. Rise up, O Lord. Let the nations know they are but men.
Why, O Lord, do you stand far away? The helpless commits himself to you.
In the Lord I take refuge. If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
Save, O Lord, for the godly one is gone. The words of the Lord are pure words.
How long, O Lord? I will sing to the Lord, because he has dealt bountifully with me.
The fool says in his heart, there is no God. Oh that salvation would come out of Zion.
Who shall dwell on your holy hill? He who walks blamelessly and speaks truth in his heart.
Preserve me, O God. You will not abandon my soul to Sheol. At your right hand are pleasures forevermore.
Hear a just cause. Hide me in the shadow of your wings. I shall behold your face in righteousness.
I love you, O Lord, my strength. He drew me out of many waters. This God — his way is perfect.
The heavens declare the glory of God. The law of the Lord is perfect. Let the words of my mouth be acceptable.
May the Lord answer you in the day of trouble. Some trust in chariots. We trust in the name of the Lord.
The king rejoices in your strength. You set a crown of fine gold upon his head.
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? They divide my garments. All the ends of the earth shall remember.
The Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want. I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.
The earth is the Lord’s. Who shall ascend the hill of the Lord? Lift up your heads, O gates.
To you, O Lord, I lift up my soul. Make me to know your ways. Forgive my guilt, for it is great.
Vindicate me, O Lord. I wash my hands in innocence. I love the habitation of your house.
The Lord is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Wait for the Lord.
To you, O Lord, I call. The Lord is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation.
Ascribe to the Lord glory and strength. The voice of the Lord over the waters. The Lord sits enthroned as king forever.
I will extol you, O Lord, for you have drawn me up. Weeping may tarry for the night, but joy comes with the morning.
In you, O Lord, I take refuge. Into your hand I commit my spirit. Be strong, and let your heart take courage.
Blessed is the one whose transgression is forgiven. I acknowledged my sin. You are a hiding place.
Shout for joy in the Lord, O you righteous. He spoke, and it came to be. The eye of the Lord is on those who fear him.
I will bless the Lord at all times. Taste and see that the Lord is good. The Lord is near to the brokenhearted.
Contend, O Lord, with those who contend with me. Say to my soul, I am your salvation.
Transgression speaks to the wicked. With you is the fountain of life. In your light do we see light.
Fret not yourself because of evildoers. Trust in the Lord and do good. The meek shall inherit the land.
O Lord, rebuke me not in your anger. My wounds stink and fester. Do not forsake me, O Lord.
I said, I will guard my ways. I am a sojourner with you. Look away from me, that I may smile again.
I waited patiently for the Lord. He drew me up from the pit. I delight to do your will, O my God.
Blessed is the one who considers the poor. Even my close friend has lifted his heel against me.
As a deer pants for flowing streams. Why are you cast down, O my soul? Hope in God.
Vindicate me, O God. Send out your light and your truth. Hope in God; for I shall again praise him.
We have heard with our ears. You have made us a taunt. Awake. Why do you hide your face?
My heart overflows with a pleasing theme. Your throne, O God, is forever. The queen in gold of Ophir.
God is our refuge and strength. Be still, and know that I am God.
Clap your hands, all peoples. God has gone up with a shout. He is highly exalted.
Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised in the city of our God. Walk about Zion.
Hear this, all peoples. Man in his pomp will not remain. God will ransom my soul from the power of Sheol.
The Mighty One, God the Lord, speaks. If I were hungry, I would not tell you. The one who offers thanksgiving.
Have mercy on me, O God. Against you, you only, have I sinned. Create in me a clean heart.
Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? I am like a green olive tree in the house of God.
The fool says in his heart, there is no God. Oh that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion.
O God, save me by your name. The Lord is the upholder of my life.
Give ear to my prayer, O God. It is not an enemy who taunts me, but you, a man, my companion.
Be gracious to me, O God, for man tramples on me. In God I trust; I shall not be afraid.
Be merciful to me, O God. In the shadow of your wings I will take refuge. My heart is steadfast.
Do you indeed decree what is right, you gods? The righteous will rejoice when he sees the vengeance.
Deliver me from my enemies, O my God. O my Strength, I will watch for you.
O God, you have rejected us. You have set up a banner for those who fear you. With God we shall do valiantly.
Hear my cry, O God. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I. Let me dwell in your tent forever.
For God alone my soul waits in silence. Trust in him at all times, O people. Pour out your heart before him.
O God, you are my God; earnestly I seek you. My soul thirsts for you in a dry and weary land.
Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint. Let the righteous one rejoice in the Lord.
Praise is due to you, O God, in Zion. You visit the earth and water it. The meadows clothe themselves with flocks.
Shout for joy to God, all the earth. Come and see what God has done. We went through fire and through water.
May God be gracious to us and bless us. Let the peoples praise you, O God. Let all the peoples praise you.
Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered. Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears us up. Our God is a God of salvation.
Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck. Zeal for your house has consumed me. They gave me vinegar.
Make haste, O God, to deliver me. Let those who seek you rejoice. You are my help and my deliverer.
In you, O Lord, I take refuge. Do not cast me off in the time of old age. I will remind them of your righteousness.
Give the king your justice, O God. He delivers the needy. May his name endure forever. The prayers of David are ended.
Truly God is good to Israel. I was envious of the arrogant. Then I went into the sanctuary. Whom have I in heaven but you?
O God, why do you cast us off forever? They set your sanctuary on fire. Remember this, O Lord.
We give thanks to you, O God. At the set time that I appoint I will judge with equity.
In Judah God is known. Glorious are you, more majestic than the mountains of prey. Make your vows to the Lord.
I cry aloud to God. I will remember the deeds of the Lord. Your way was through the sea; yet your footprints were unseen.
Give ear, O my people, to my teaching. A parable from of old. He chose David his servant.
O God, the nations have come into your inheritance. How long? Help us, O God of our salvation.
Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel. Restore us. Let your face shine, that we may be saved.
Sing aloud to God our strength. I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide.
God has taken his place in the divine council. How long will you judge unjustly? Arise, O God, judge the earth.
O God, do not keep silence. Your enemies make an uproar. Let them know that you, whose name is the Lord, are the Most High.
How lovely is your dwelling place. A day in your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere.
Lord, you were favourable to your land. Steadfast love and faithfulness meet. Righteousness and peace kiss.
Incline your ear, O Lord. Teach me your way. I give thanks to you, O Lord my God, with my whole heart.
On the holy mount stands the city he founded. Glorious things of you are spoken, O city of God. This one and that one were born in her.
O Lord, God of my salvation, I cry out. You have put me in the depths of the pit. Darkness is my only companion.
I will sing of the steadfast love of the Lord forever. I have made a covenant with my chosen one. How long, O Lord?
Lord, you have been our dwelling place in all generations. Teach us to number our days. Let the favour of the Lord our God be upon us.
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High. He will command his angels concerning you. I will be with him in trouble.
It is good to give thanks to the Lord. The righteous flourish like the palm tree. The Lord is upright.
The Lord reigns; he is robed in majesty. Mightier than the thunders of many waters.
O Lord, God of vengeance. How long shall the wicked exult? The Lord will not forsake his people.
Oh come, let us sing to the Lord. Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts.
Oh sing to the Lord a new song. Splendour and majesty are before him. He will judge the world in righteousness.
The Lord reigns, let the earth rejoice. Light is sown for the righteous. Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous.
Oh sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done marvellous things. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
The Lord reigns; let the peoples tremble. Exalt the Lord our God. Holy is he.
Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
I will sing of steadfast love and justice. I will walk with integrity of heart within my house.
Hear my prayer, O Lord. My days pass away like smoke. You, O Lord, are enthroned forever.
Bless the Lord, O my soul. He forgives all your iniquity. As a father shows compassion to his children.
Bless the Lord, O my soul. He makes the clouds his chariot. You send forth your Spirit, they are created.
Oh give thanks to the Lord; call upon his name. He remembers his covenant forever. Joseph. Moses. They forgot.
Praise the Lord. We have sinned. They forgot God their Saviour. Yet he remembered his covenant. Save us, O Lord our God.
Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good. Let the redeemed of the Lord say so. Some wandered, some sat in darkness, some were fools, some went down to the sea.
My heart is steadfast, O God. Awake, O harp and lyre. With God we shall do valiantly.
Be not silent, O God of my praise. They encircle me with words of hate. But you, O God my Lord, deal on my behalf.
The Lord says to my Lord: sit at my right hand. You are a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
Praise the Lord. Great are the works of the Lord. The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom. His praise endures forever.
Praise the Lord. Blessed is the one who fears the Lord. His offspring will be mighty in the land.
Praise the Lord. Who is like the Lord our God, who raises the poor from the dust.
When Israel went out from Egypt. The sea looked and fled. Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord.
Not to us, O Lord, not to us. Their idols are silver and gold. We will bless the Lord from this time forth.
I love the Lord, because he has heard my voice. What shall I render to the Lord? I will lift up the cup of salvation.
Praise the Lord, all nations. For great is his steadfast love toward us.
Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good. The stone that the builders rejected. This is the day that the Lord has made.
Blessed are those whose way is blameless. Your word is a lamp to my feet. Great peace have those who love your law. (The long acrostic.)
In my distress I called to the Lord. I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.
I lift up my eyes to the hills. My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
I was glad when they said to me, let us go to the house of the Lord. Pray for the peace of Jerusalem.
To you I lift up my eyes, O you who are enthroned in the heavens. Have mercy upon us.
If it had not been the Lord who was on our side. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion. As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people.
When the Lord restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dream. Those who sow in tears shall reap with shouts of joy.
Unless the Lord builds the house. Children are a heritage from the Lord. Blessed is the man who fills his quiver.
Blessed is everyone who fears the Lord, who walks in his ways. Your wife will be like a fruitful vine.
Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth. The Lord is righteous; he has cut the cords of the wicked.
Out of the depths I cry to you, O Lord. With you there is forgiveness. I wait for the Lord, my soul waits.
O Lord, my heart is not lifted up. I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child.
Remember, O Lord, in David’s favour. The Lord has chosen Zion. There I will make a horn to sprout for David.
Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers dwell in unity. Like the dew of Hermon.
Come, bless the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, who stand by night in the house of the Lord.
Praise the Lord. Praise the name of the Lord. Whatever the Lord pleases, he does. Your name, O Lord, endures forever.
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good. His steadfast love endures forever. To him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt.
By the waters of Babylon, there we sat down and wept. How shall we sing the Lord’s song in a foreign land?
I give you thanks, O Lord, with my whole heart. The Lord will fulfil his purpose for me. Do not forsake the work of your hands.
O Lord, you have searched me and known me. Where shall I go from your Spirit? Search me, O God, and know my heart.
Deliver me, O Lord, from evil men. Let burning coals fall upon them. I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted.
O Lord, I call upon you; hasten to me. Let my prayer be counted as incense. Set a guard, O Lord, over my mouth.
With my voice I cry out to the Lord. When my spirit faints within me, you know my way. Bring me out of prison.
Hear my prayer, O Lord. No one living is righteous before you. Let me hear in the morning of your steadfast love.
Blessed be the Lord, my rock. Rescue me. May our sons in their youth be as plants full grown.
I will extol you, my God and King. Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised. The Lord is near to all who call on him.
Praise the Lord. Put not your trust in princes. The Lord opens the eyes of the blind. The Lord will reign forever.
Praise the Lord. He heals the brokenhearted. He determines the number of the stars. He has not dealt thus with any other nation.
Praise the Lord from the heavens. Praise him, sun and moon. Let them praise the name of the Lord, for his name alone is exalted.
Praise the Lord. Sing to the Lord a new song. Let the high praises of God be in their throats and two-edged swords in their hands.
Praise the Lord. Praise God in his sanctuary. Let everything that has breath praise the Lord. Praise the Lord.
proverbs: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge. Hear, my son. Wisdom cries aloud in the street.
If you call out for insight. He stores up sound wisdom for the upright. Discretion will watch over you.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart. Honour the Lord with your wealth. Do not despise his discipline.
Hear, O sons, a father’s instruction. Get wisdom. The path of the righteous is like the light of dawn.
My son, be attentive to my wisdom. Drink water from your own cistern. The Lord watches the paths of life.
If you have put up security. Go to the ant, O sluggard. Six things the Lord hates, seven.
My son, keep my words. A woman with the attire of a prostitute. Her house is the way to Sheol.
Does not wisdom call? The Lord possessed me at the beginning. Whoever finds me finds life.
Wisdom has built her house. Leave your simple ways. The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
A wise son makes a glad father. The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life. Hatred stirs up strife.
A false balance is an abomination. When pride comes, then comes disgrace. The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life.
Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge. The way of a fool is right in his own eyes. Anxiety in a person’s heart weighs him down.
A wise son hears his father’s instruction. Hope deferred makes the heart sick. Whoever walks with the wise becomes wise.
The wisest of women builds her house. In all toil there is profit. Even in laughter the heart may ache.
A soft answer turns away wrath. The eyes of the Lord are in every place. A gentle tongue is a tree of life.
The plans of the heart belong to man. Commit your work to the Lord. Pride goes before destruction.
Better is a dry morsel with quiet. A friend loves at all times. A joyful heart is good medicine.
Whoever isolates himself. The name of the Lord is a strong tower. Death and life are in the power of the tongue.
Better is a poor person who walks in integrity. A false witness will not go unpunished. A desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul.
Wine is a mocker. The sluggard does not plough in autumn. Who can say, I have made my heart pure?
The king’s heart is a stream of water in the hand of the Lord. To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable than sacrifice.
A good name is to be chosen rather than great riches. Train up a child. The rich and the poor meet together.
When you sit down to eat with a ruler. Do not wear yourself out to get rich. Buy truth, and do not sell it.
Be not envious of evil men. If you faint in the day of adversity. Know well the condition of your flocks.
These also are proverbs of Solomon which the men of Hezekiah copied. It is the glory of God to conceal things.
Like snow in summer. A whip for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools.
Do not boast about tomorrow. Let another praise you, and not your own mouth. Iron sharpens iron. Faithful are the wounds of a friend.
The wicked flee when no one pursues. Whoever conceals his transgressions will not prosper. He who trusts in his own mind is a fool.
He who is often reproved, yet stiffens his neck. Where there is no prophetic vision the people cast off restraint. Open your mouth for the mute.
The words of Agur. Two things I ask. Four things that are small yet wise. If you have been foolish in exalting yourself.
The words of King Lemuel. An oracle that his mother taught him. An excellent wife who can find? Give her of the fruit of her hands.
ecclesiastes: Vanity of vanities. What does man gain by all the toil. There is nothing new under the sun.
I said in my heart, come now, I will test you with pleasure. Wisdom excels folly as light excels darkness. Yet one event happens to all.
For everything there is a season. He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has put eternity into man’s heart.
I saw all the oppressions. Two are better than one. A threefold cord is not quickly broken.
Guard your steps when you go to the house of God. God is in heaven and you are on earth. The sleep of a labourer is sweet.
There is an evil that I have seen: a man to whom God gives wealth, yet he does not enjoy it.
A good name is better than precious ointment. Be not overly righteous. God made man upright, but they have sought out many schemes.
Keep the king’s command. Man does not know what is to be. Though a sinner does evil a hundred times and prolongs his life.
All this I laid to heart. The living know that they will die. Enjoy life with the wife whom you love. Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might.
Dead flies make the perfumer’s ointment give off a stench. Cast your bread upon the waters. Rejoice, O young man — but know that for all these things God will bring you into judgment.
Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth. The dust returns to the earth, and the spirit returns to God who gave it. Vanity of vanities.
The Preacher sought to find words of delight. Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole of man. God will bring every deed into judgment.
songofsolomon: The song of songs. Let him kiss me. I am dark but lovely. Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you pasture.
I am a rose of Sharon. He brought me to the banqueting house. Do not stir up love until it pleases. The voice of my beloved.
On my bed at night I sought him. I will seek him whom my soul loves. Behold, it is the litter of Solomon.
Behold, you are beautiful, my love. A garden locked. Awake, O north wind. Let my beloved come to his garden.
I slept, but my heart was awake. I opened to my beloved, but he had turned and gone. I am sick with love.
Where has your beloved gone. You are beautiful as Tirzah. Who is this who looks down like the dawn.
How beautiful are your feet in sandals. I am my beloved’s, and his desire is for me. Come, my beloved, let us go out into the fields.
Set me as a seal upon your heart. Love is strong as death. Many waters cannot quench love. Make haste, my beloved.
